name: Apollo Burger (Orem & PG, UT) Charbroiled Lemon-Herb Chicken Breast on Warm Pita
whyItWorks: Tender flame-broiled chicken breast wrapped inside a thick, soft Greek pita bread with light tzatziki cucumber yogurt. Pure lean protein and soft bread.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Chicken Pita with light tzatziki (hold raw red onions and sliced tomatoes).
